device.description: 12-bit 200-kSPS 11-channel low-power serial ADC with internal reference, programmable output length/order, unipolar or bipolar output and INT/EOC
device.note: tlv2556.pdf (SLAS355B) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.5 tconvert, p.8-9 timing requirements, p.23 data I/O, sampling and conversion cycle, INT behavior, p.24 power up and default mode, p.25 Table 2 command set and CFGR1/CFGR2, p.25-26 data length, LSB first, bipolar, p.27 INT/EOC output and CS, p.28 power down; same content in tlv2556-ep.pdf (TLV2556-EP)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: CMR (D7-D4) and CFGR1 (D3-D0) of the input data register (Table 2, p.25); set to all zeroes at power up (p.24)

registers.name: CFGR2
registers.note: internal: configuration register 2 (Table 2, p.25), written by command 1111b; p.24 says both configuration registers are all zeroes at power up (D3-D2 = 00 is the internal 4.096-V reference although Table 2 marks 11 as the default)

commands.name: ACCESS CFGR2, default mode (1111b, D0 = 1)
commands.note: p.24 default mode / Table 2 (p.25): CFGR2 D0 = 1 sets CFGR1 D3-D0 and CFGR2 D3-D1 to their defaults (external reference, pin 19 EOC, 12-bit MSB-first unipolar) and selects AIN0; DATA IN held high (FFh) keeps converting AIN0

commands.name: ACCESS CFGR2
commands.note: Table 2 (p.25): command 1111b writes CFGR2 from SDI D3-D0 (D3-D2 reference select, D1 pin 19 EOC/INT, D0 default mode)

commands.name: Software power down (address 1110), 8-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: Table 2 (p.25) / p.28: command 1110b selects software power down; no conversion is performed, the I/O cycle must still be completed

commands.name: Software power down (address 1110), 12-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: Table 2 (p.25) / p.28: command 1110b selects software power down; no conversion is performed, the I/O cycle must still be completed

commands.name: Software power down (address 1110), 12-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: Table 2 (p.25) / p.28: command 1110b selects software power down; no conversion is performed, the I/O cycle must still be completed

commands.name: Software power down (address 1110), 16-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: Table 2 (p.25) / p.28: command 1110b selects software power down; no conversion is performed, the I/O cycle must still be completed

commands.name: Select channel / test voltage, 8-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: Table 2 (p.25): D7-D4 command (0000b-1010b AIN0-AIN10, 1011b-1101b self-test), CFGR1 D3-D2 output length (01 = 8, x0 = 12, 11 = 16), D1 LSB first, D0 bipolar 2s complement; the conversion starts after the last (8th/12th/16th) I/O CLOCK falling edge (p.23-25)

commands.name: Select channel / test voltage, 12-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: Table 2 (p.25): D7-D4 command (0000b-1010b AIN0-AIN10, 1011b-1101b self-test), CFGR1 D3-D2 output length (01 = 8, x0 = 12, 11 = 16), D1 LSB first, D0 bipolar 2s complement; the conversion starts after the last (8th/12th/16th) I/O CLOCK falling edge (p.23-25)

commands.name: Select channel / test voltage, 12-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: Table 2 (p.25): D7-D4 command (0000b-1010b AIN0-AIN10, 1011b-1101b self-test), CFGR1 D3-D2 output length (01 = 8, x0 = 12, 11 = 16), D1 LSB first, D0 bipolar 2s complement; the conversion starts after the last (8th/12th/16th) I/O CLOCK falling edge (p.23-25)

commands.name: Select channel / test voltage, 16-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: Table 2 (p.25): D7-D4 command (0000b-1010b AIN0-AIN10, 1011b-1101b self-test), CFGR1 D3-D2 output length (01 = 8, x0 = 12, 11 = 16), D1 LSB first, D0 bipolar 2s complement; the conversion starts after the last (8th/12th/16th) I/O CLOCK falling edge (p.23-25)

ready.note: CFGR2 D1 = 0: EOC, low from the last I/O CLOCK falling edge until the conversion is complete (p.27)
CFGR2 D1 = 1: INT, falls when the conversion is complete, cleared by the next CS falling edge or I/O CLOCK rising edge (p.23, p.27)

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.5 (tconvert 5.54 us at 2.7-3.6 V), p.9 (timing at VCC = 2.7 V: td1 30 ns, td2 10 ns, td3 33 ns), p.23 (I/O cycle, conversion, INT), p.24 (power up, default mode), p.25 (Table 2), p.25-26 (data length, LSB first, bipolar), p.27 (INT/EOC, CS), p.28 (power down)
notModeled: analog inputs, internal 2.048/4.096-V reference (CFGR2 D3-D2) and multiplexer: every conversion returns the 0 V code (unipolar 000h; bipolar (CFGR1 D0 = 1) 800h, the code of VREF- = 0 V: modeled as codeFormat offset)
self-test commands 1011b/1100b/1101b: modeled as conversions returning the 0 V code
software power down (1110b; 1 ms resume with the internal reference) and auto power down: modeled as an I/O cycle that starts no conversion

ACCESS CFGR2 (1111b): modeled as an 8-bit write of CFGR2 that starts no conversion (the datasheet does not say whether this cycle converts); with D0 = 1 (default mode) it loads the defaults and converts AIN0, the conversion starting at the 8th I/O CLOCK (the following 4 clocks of the 12-bit cycle are not waited for); leaving default mode (the host must program CFGR1 on the next cycle) is not enforced
data length: CFGR1 D3-D2 applies to the current I/O cycle; MSB-first output is the same for every length, LSB-first ordering uses the length and LSBF of the previous cycle
result pipelining (output is the previous conversion, first result after power up random): the result is constant

CS held low continuously (first bit at EOC rising / INT falling, INT cleared by the next I/O CLOCK rising edge td9): only CS-framed transfers are modeled; INT clearing is modeled at CS falling or when the result is read
conversion start: after the last I/O CLOCK falling edge (td4 75 ns to EOC); modeled at the last rising edge (command completion)
CS abort of a conversion (td5 1.5 us), CS debounce
timing at VCC = 2.7 V, VREF+ = 2.5 V (p.9): tValid = td1 30 ns, tOut = td3 33 ns, tFloat = td2 10 ns
variants: tlv2556.pdf covers TLV2556I (IPWR); tlv2556-ep.pdf covers TLV2556-EP (MPWREP) with the same pinout and interface.
